tasks.instruction: Add appearance UI and browser checks to connected-global preview. Allowed app/connected-global-preview.js, tools/connected-global-preview.html, docs/qa/claude-appearance-ui.md only. Lead concurrently implements renderer.draw(state,{polished=true,ao=true,...existing}) and read(state,width,height,{polished=true,ao=true}) preserving debug packets exactly, plus readColor(state,width,height,{polished=true,ao=true}) returning Uint8Array RGBA. Add checked polished-lighting and AO checkboxes, draw uses both, honest UI AO is local heuristic not cross-portal shadowing. Existing diagnostic/approach controls preserved. In ?check compare identical debug packets before/after style/AO toggles and require visible color difference basic vs polished. Save same-pose basic/polished/noAO screenshots. For meaningful AO effect create a test-only cloned fixture adding E3 plane floor at z=-.65 (upz) under flat-target ball centerz0 r.6; target seen from flat return pose. Use independent model/renderer for floor fixture (do not mutate main fixture). AO must darken some HIT pixels, not brighten them; do not require effect on distant isolated balls. No threshold weakening, renderer/engine edits or root queue/browser from clone. Report checks unrun pending lead renderer if needed. No commits/pushes/agents. Keep report <400words.
